title: The Stars with Rhonda: The Harvest Is Coming for You
description: Rhonda reads the autumn signs as serene cosmic fact while Ronnie hunts for an upside. Casseroles, pumpkin patches, and a hayride curdle into doom. The harvest does not ask. But it does knock.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: The stars, with Rhonda. It's harvest season, Rhonda. Cozy stuff, right?

lines.speaker: rhonda
lines.text: Virgo. Your casserole wins the church bake-off. You will not be there to accept. The harvest does not ask.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: It won though! That's a win, that's a positive.

lines.speaker: rhonda
lines.text: Libra. Avoid the pumpkin patch. The largest gourd knows your name, and is disappointed in you.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Disappointed? In me? <p:0.3> What did the gourd hear?

lines.speaker: rhonda
lines.text: Scorpio. A hayride leaves at dusk. Everyone you have wronged is already seated. There is one open spot. It is yours.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Okay, it's getting closer, Rhonda, I don't love how it keeps getting closer.

lines.speaker: rhonda
lines.text: Capricorn. The scarecrow you waved at this morning waved back. <p:0.3> It is in the building. It would like a word.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: That's, that's my sign! But a scarecrow waving back, that's friendly, right?

lines.speaker: rhonda
lines.text: It is being polite. The harvest does not ask, Ronnie. <p:0.3> But it does knock.
